snippet.title: Toss Office – Official Trailer | Pixel Art Incremental Game
snippet.description:
Toss Office is an incremental game about procrastinating. Play a new hire at the Department of Disposal, toss and shred paper your way up the ladder, and hire a team to do your work for you. 🗑️

⭐ Wishlist on Steam

It's a boring job that pays the bills: shred the documents every other department sends your way. Luckily, you'll find a way to make it fun.

FEATURES
📋 Meet management objectives : process enough documents, earn money and get rewarded by management
⬆️ Upgrade your skills : spend coins on upgrades for yourself, your team and the office furniture
👥 Delegate your work : hire staff to keep shredding while you slack off
🪴 Decorate your office : buy furniture and decorations in the company shop and make the place your own
🖱️ Clicker meets idle : a short, satisfying incremental game in hand-crafted pixel art

Release: "Coming soon"
Platforms: PC 

Developed by Ravenous Den
